name: pay_toll
description: Pay a micropayment toll to access a paywalled resource. Use this when you encounter an HTTP 402 Payment Required response. The tool handles the payment via Solana USDC and returns an access token for the resource.

url.description: The URL of the resource that requires payment (from the 402 response)

amount.description: The payment amount in USDC (from the 402 response x402 headers or body)

max_amount.description: Maximum amount you're willing to pay. If the requested amount exceeds this, the tool will not proceed. Default: 0.05 USDC

reason.description: Why accessing this resource is valuable for your current task (helps with logging and human oversight)
